title: ServiceVehicle
description: The service profile of one Vehicle that does work in the network: a tow truck, a car transporter, a replacement car, or a roadside mechanic's van. It is held in the vehicle's own eVault beside that vehicle's Vehicle record, under the same eName, so a service vehicle is still a vehicle: it can break down, be condition-reported and be handed over like any other. A vehicle without a ServiceVehicle record is an ordinary vehicle. Identity (registration, make, model, weight, dimensions, drivetrain) lives on Vehicle only and is deliberately not repeated here; what lives here is what the service role adds, plus operational state (position, status, assignment) that changes far more often than standing data. Matching happens against this record and not against the company: a recovery company does not have a lift capacity, a specific truck does. Garage machines and equipment are deliberately not modelled as service vehicles; they are summarised in ProviderCapability.repair.equipmentHeld.

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the eVault holding this record: the vehicle itself, the same eVault that holds its Vehicle record

eName.description: eName of the vehicle eVault. Equal to Vehicle.eName; this is the eName jobs and availability records refer to.

serviceRole.description: What the vehicle does in the network. recovery: tow truck; transport: car transporter; replacement: a car lent to a driver; roadside: a mechanic's van, which carries no role block.

operatorEName.description: eName of the organisation that offers the vehicle for service work and publishes its availability. Usually the vehicle's legal owner (Vehicle.ownerEName); differs for a leased vehicle. The person driving it is Vehicle.currentDriverEName.

liftCapacityKg.description: Heaviest vehicle the truck can lift onto its bed, in kilograms

towCapacityKg.description: Heaviest vehicle the truck can tow behind it, in kilograms

towingMethods.description: Towing methods the truck can perform

winch.description: Whether the truck has a winch, for a vehicle that cannot roll

crane.description: Whether the truck has a crane, for a vehicle off the road

evContainment.description: Whether the truck can carry a damaged electric vehicle with containment against a battery fire

transport.description: Present for serviceRole transport. Capacities describe the load, not the transporter itself.

slots.description: Number of vehicles the transporter carries when full

freeSlots.description: Number of those places free right now

maxWeightKg.description: Heaviest vehicle one place can take, in kilograms

maxLengthMm.description: Longest vehicle one place can take, in millimetres

maxHeightMm.description: Tallest vehicle one place can take, in millimetres

covered.description: Whether the transporter is enclosed, protecting the load from weather and view

canLoadNonRolling.description: Whether the transporter can load a vehicle that cannot roll, with a winch or lift

replacement.description: Present for serviceRole replacement. Drivetrain and transmission are read from the Vehicle record.

vehicleClass.description: Rental class of the car, such as compact, estate or van

minDriverAge.description: Youngest age at which a driver may be given the car

licenceClassRequired.description: Driving licence class the driver must hold, such as B

availableFrom.description: From when the car can be lent out

availableUntil.description: Until when the car can be lent out

homeBaseEnvelopeId.description: ServiceLocation the vehicle operates out of

reportedAt.description: When the position was last reported

currentAssignmentEnvelopeId.description: The recovery, transport or mobility job the vehicle is currently committed to

status.description: Whether the vehicle can take work now. assigned means currentAssignmentEnvelopeId names its job.

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
